sources.title: DeepSeek Models Guide: R1, V3, and Coder | InsiderLLM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek made the biggest splash in local AI when R1 dropped in January 2025 — a reasoning model that matched OpenAI's o1 on math benchmarks, fully open-source, with distilled versions that run on a single consumer GPU. But DeepSeek has a whole family of models now: R1, V3, V3.1, Coder V2, and more. It's confusing.
